name: White Fudge
subtitle: A favorite of Grandma Kemper and her sister Aunt Margaret
time: ~2 hr 30 min, ~45 min hands-on (mostly cooling; estimated)

steps.title: Combine in pan
steps.body: Butter inside of pan, then combine in pan: **4 cups white sugar**, **1½ cups cream** and **2 Tbsp white corn syrup**.

steps.title: Boil to soft ball
steps.body: Heat over medium heat, and stir constantly, scraping sides until it boils. Stop stirring, and boil until 240°F (soft ball stage). Don’t overcook.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Cover tightly and cool quickly and thoroughly.

steps.title: Beat
steps.body: Remove from pan and beat in mixer until fudge consistency, then add: **1 tsp vanilla** and nuts (toasted pecans if possible).

steps.title: Pour and hide
steps.body: Pour into a buttered pan, and hide.
